high_level_description: The image depicts the United States Capitol building at night, illuminated against a dark blue sky. The iconic dome of the Capitol is prominently featured, showcasing its intricate architectural details and the statue of Freedom atop it. The building's facade is lit up, highlighting its grandeur and historical significance. In the foreground, part of another building is visible on the left side of the image, suggesting that the photo was taken from a vantage point outside the Capitol grounds.
